name: Nancy Cindy Martiz
office: City of Huntington Park, Member of the City Council, 2nd District (Unexpired term ending December 8, 2028)

items.text: Nancy Cindy Martiz is a Huntington Park City Council member, appointed in April 2025 to fill a vacancy. She previously served on the city’s Civil Service Commission. According to the city, she has more than a decade of human resources and employee benefits experience and leads national HR policy at The Walt Disney Company. She holds a bachelor’s in government and American studies from Smith College and a master’s in public administration and policy from CSU Long Beach.

items.text: According to a city press release, her priorities include clean air, affordable housing, green space expansion, and safe streets. Her campaign website says she advocates for protecting immigrants, keeping residents housed, investing in aging infrastructure, and restoring parks.
